name: Creamy Parmesan Garlic Pork Chops (Skillet)
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
why: Verified 507 cal / 10g carbs / 26g protein per source card - centered in the 400-650 band and well under the 35g carb ceiling. Structurally low-carb (pork + cream + parmesan sauce, no rice/pasta/potato). Every ingredient maps to the board (pork-chops, butter, olive-oil, onions, garlic, chicken-broth, heavy-cream, dried-basil, garlic-powder, parmesan, fresh-parsley). One-skillet, weigh-and-divide friendly at 14 servings. Distinct from existing creamy-mushroom-pork-chops-over-mashed-potatoes (no mushroom, no starch base).
